title: Ellesse Released A New Single, "Too Much"
htmlContent:
The American singer and songwriter Ellesse recently released her newest single, "Too Much," full of life and energy. She delivers happy Pop notes with many melancholy melodies and weight in the appropriate measure. With that, we have a fantastic mix between the best of R&B and her incredible voice. 

She has a lot of vocal talent and presents a tremendous performance that fits perfectly with the proposed musical base. 

Stream "Too Much" on Spotify
